d:
Karnataka has alleged that petrol samples from several oil companies contained up to 31.2% ethanol, exceeding the prescribed E20 blend. The Centre has rejected the claims, saying all 893 samples tested across 27 states and Union Territories, including 56 from Karnataka, met BIS standards. The dispute has raised questions over fuel testing methods, vehicle mileage, maintenance costs and consumer compensation.
